name: Shirosaki Yuuri
source:
A beautiful girl from ordinary family who attends the school as a scholarship student.
Has many closet fans because of her gentle manners and lovely presense. Her personality is also very calm and she behaves equally to everyone.
She worries a lot about her big breasts and tries to conceal its real size.
As a member of a gardening club, she takes care of flowers.
